# Plugin Registration

Plugins register native DCode functions at runtime. The engine appends each registration to the static feature registry returned by `dartwic/get-dcode-api-autocomplete`.

Dynamic entries use the same public fields as in-source entries: `id`, `origin`, `category`, `family`, `editorKind`, `contexts`, `inputArguments`, and `outputArguments`. Their origin is `Plugin-provided`.

The registry is dynamic, so individual plugin functions appear in editor completion and hover metadata when their plugin is loaded rather than as checked-in generated pages.
